acceptanceCriteria: Fixture with two repositories: a claim anchored in repository B builds, appears in `docs_search`/`docs_get` with `repository = B` and B's revision, and goes `stale` when the file changes in B (not in A).
An anchor naming an undeclared repository is still refused.
Single-repository manifests are byte-identical to today.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1243 (filed 2026-10-19 against build main-fa8afe6). A documentation corpus anchors exactly one repository. Every provider anchor must carry `repository == manifest.repository.id`, and every scope revision must resolve to that same repository identity. Documentation that describes a system spread over several repositories (an application, a shared library, a separate end-to-end test repository) can only be imported by copying the other repositories' files under path prefixes into one scratch repository. The anchors then lose their real repository identity and revision, freshness is checked against the wrong history, and downstream consumers cannot map a citation back to the real file. `/2` behaviour contracts already list other repositories, but only to record a `repository-evidence-unavailable` gap.
title: Corpus anchors into additional declared repositories at their own pinned revisions (GitHub #1243)
